business_domains.description: This domain manages the catalog of products/items available for quoting and ordering. It is responsible for maintaining product master data, including product identifiers (SKU numbers), descriptions, pricing, inventory levels, and lead times. The catalog serves as the reference product data used when building quotes. Core capabilities include retrieving the full catalog listing, looking up individual catalog items by SKU, adding new catalog items, updating existing items, and removing items from the catalog. The domain exposes a RESTful API under the '/catalog' path and uses both MongoDB-backed and in-memory persistence implementations. The CatalogItems database table is the primary data store for this domain.

This domain manages the dealers (suppliers/partners) in the ordering system. It maintains dealer profiles including dealer name, primary contact name, address, email, and phone number. Dealers are associated with quotes, linking commercial relationships to pricing agreements. Core capabilities include retrieving all dealers, looking up a dealer by name, adding new dealers, updating dealer information, and removing dealers. The domain exposes a RESTful API under the '/dealers' path and uses both MongoDB-backed and in-memory persistence. The Dealers database table is the primary data store. Dealer information is referenced by the Quote domain when creating or validating quotes.

This domain handles the creation and management of customer price quotes. A quote represents a formal pricing offer to a customer, associated with a specific dealer, containing one or more quoted line items (referencing catalog SKU numbers with amounts), pricing information (total cost, discount), validity period, and delivery location details (city, state, postal code). Core business capabilities include creating new quotes, retrieving quotes by ID or by customer name, updating quote details, and deleting quotes. The Quote domain also supports querying quotes by dealer name. It depends on the Dealer domain for dealer validation and the Product Catalog domain for item references. The Quotes and QuoteAdditionalItemRecord database tables form the data boundary for this domain. The domain exposes its API under the '/quotes' path.

This domain manages the lifecycle of customer orders, which are created from approved quotes. An order tracks the transition from a quote to a fulfillment action, maintaining status (e.g., Created, Fulfilled, Cancelled) and a chronological event log of activities with comments and timestamps. Core business capabilities include creating an order from a quote, retrieving orders by ID or by dealer name, updating order details, updating order status with associated event notes, logging order events, and deleting orders. The domain owns the Orders and OrderEvents database tables. Order status is a key concept shared across this domain and the Shipment domain. The domain exposes its REST API under the '/orders' path and depends on the Quote domain to validate the referenced quote when creating an order.

This domain is responsible for managing the physical fulfillment and delivery of orders. It tracks shipment records linked to orders, including delivery date, delivery address (street, city, state, postal code, special instructions), primary and alternate contact person information (name and phone numbers with type/kind), and a shipment event log for tracking the progression of delivery activities. The domain also supports retrieving completed deliveries with the full context of the associated quote and order. Core capabilities include creating shipment records for orders, retrieving shipment records by order ID or by order status, updating shipment details, adding shipment tracking events, and querying all deliveries. The domain owns the ShipmentRecords, ShipmentEventInfo, DeliveryAddress, and PhoneInfo database tables and exposes its API under the '/shipments' path. It depends on the Order domain to validate referenced orders and retrieve order status context.
